_comment: One entry per country (or trip). 'continent' groups the list. 'photos' is a list of { "src": "images/travel/<file>.jpg", "caption": "..." } — put the image files in public/images/travel/. The first photo is shown large; up to three appear on the card and all of them open in a viewer when clicked. 'bestPart' is shown as the highlight of the trip. Entries with "placeholder": true are examples — replace or delete them.
intro: Travel is one of my favourite ways to spend time away from research. Here are some of the places I have visited, with a few photos and the best part of each trip.
